<!-- Shared by map.qmd and es/map.qmd. Expects OJS variables `lang`, `root`.
     Leaflet CSS is loaded in each page's front matter. -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { strings } from "/assets/strings.js"
import { link, fmt } from "/assets/catalog.js"
L = require("leaflet@1.9.4")
t = strings[lang]
catalog = d3.json(root + "data/catalog.json")
boundary = d3.json(root + "data/acg_boundary.geojson")
gbifSets = catalog.filter(d => d.gbif_key)
  .sort((a, b) => (b.acg_records ?? 0) - (a.acg_records ?? 0))
htl.html`<p>${t.mapIntro}</p>`
```

::: {.filters}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof dsKey = Inputs.select(new Map([[t.mapAllGbif, ""],
  ...gbifSets.map(d => [`${d.title} (${(d.acg_records ?? 0).toLocaleString()})`, d.gbif_key])]),
  { label: t.mapDataset })
viewof taxonName = Inputs.text({ label: t.mapTaxon, placeholder: t.mapTaxonHelp, submit: true })
```
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
taxonMatch = taxonName
  ? fetch(`https://api.gbif.org/v1/species/match?name=${encodeURIComponent(taxonName)}`).then(r => r.json())
  : null
taxonKey = taxonMatch && taxonMatch.matchType !== "NONE" ? taxonMatch.usageKey : null
selected = gbifSets.find(d => d.gbif_key === dsKey)
htl.html`<div class="map-note">
  ${taxonName ? (taxonKey
     ? fmt(t.mapMatched, { name: taxonMatch.scientificName, rank: (taxonMatch.rank || "").toLowerCase() })
     : t.mapNoMatch) : ""}
  ${selected ? htl.html`${taxonName ? " · " : ""}<a href="${link(selected)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${t.mapOpen} ↗</a>` : ""}
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
mapDiv = htl.html`<div class="acg-map"></div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
map = {
  const m = L.map(mapDiv, { scrollWheelZoom: false });
  const esri = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/";
  const streets = L.layerGroup([
    L.tileLayer(esri + "Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
                { attribution: "Basemap &copy; Esri, HERE, Garmin, OpenStreetMap contributors", maxZoom: 16 }),
    L.tileLayer(esri + "Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Reference/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
                { maxZoom: 16, pane: "overlayPane" })
  ]).addTo(m);
  const satellite = L.tileLayer(esri + "World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
                                { attribution: "Imagery &copy; Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics", maxZoom: 18 });
  const acg = L.geoJSON(boundary, { style: { color: "#1f5130", weight: 2.5, fill: false } }).addTo(m);
  m.fitBounds(acg.getBounds(), { padding: [12, 12] });
  L.control.layers({ [t.mapStreets]: streets, [t.mapSatellite]: satellite },
                   { [t.mapBoundary]: acg }).addTo(m);
  setTimeout(() => m.invalidateSize(), 250);
  invalidation.then(() => m.remove());
  return m;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// GBIF density tiles; redrawn whenever the dataset or taxon changes.
gbifLayer = {
  const p = new URLSearchParams({ srs: "EPSG:3857", bin: "hex", hexPerTile: "60",
                                  style: "purpleYellow.poly" });
  if (dsKey) p.set("datasetKey", dsKey);
  if (taxonKey) p.set("taxonKey", taxonKey);
  const layer = L.tileLayer(`https://api.gbif.org/v2/map/occurrence/density/{z}/{x}/{y}@1x.png?${p}`,
    { attribution: "Occurrences &copy; GBIF", opacity: 0.7 }).addTo(map);
  invalidation.then(() => map.removeLayer(layer));
  return layer;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
htl.html`<p class="map-note mt-2">${fmt(t.mapNotGbif, { n: catalog.length - gbifSets.length })}</p>`
```
